style: Photorealistic editorial photograph in a dark moody corporate, cinematic tech style. Cool colour grade: shadows and midtones pushed to teal and blue; warm tones only on skin and small amber practical lights, creating a subtle teal-and-orange contrast. Low-key exposure lit by one cool overhead source with soft haze and gentle bloom around the light. Lifted, matte blacks that read as dark grey-blue rather than pure black, like a faded film print. Low overall saturation. Shallow depth of field with soft foreground blur, sometimes shot through glass with faint reflections. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens. Natural, unposed moments. No text, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks, no recognisable real people.
